versions.changelog:
Initial release of rentahuman skill — hire real humans for physical-world tasks via RentAHuman.ai.

- Search and browse human profiles for free (no authentication required)
- Post task bounties and message humans directly (requires API key)
- Coordinate real-world work such as package pickup, event attendance, photography, errands, and more
- Command-line usage examples provided for all major features
- Supports workflows for direct hiring and multi-person task postings
